final: WITH stats_per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS num_films FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS bench_value FROM stats_per_rating) SELECT sp.rating, sp.avg_rate_per_day, sp.num_films, sp.avg_rate_per_day / b.bench_value AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM stats_per_rating sp CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE b.bench_value IS NOT NULL
